<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_EvanstonianRoomService"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/evanstonian-room-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RoomServiceCall" name="Room service call"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_EvanstonianRoomService" name="Evanstonian Room Service" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_RoomService">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Manager" name="Room-service manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_GuestCalls</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitKitchenTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GiveSommelierOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignWaiter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StartPreparation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Kitchen" name="Kitchen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFood</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sommelier" name="Sommelier">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlcoholIncluded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeSommelier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Waiter" name="Waiter">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StartWaiterPreparation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReadyCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeWaiterPreparation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AllReady</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnToStation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AnotherOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WaitToDebitAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DebitAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_OrderComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_GuestCalls" name="Guest calls room service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RoomServiceCall" messageRef="Message_RoomServiceCall"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeOrder" name="Take down the order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" name="Submit order ticket to the kitchen"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveSommelierOrder" name="Give the order to the sommelier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignWaiter" name="Assign the order to the waiter"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StartPreparation" name="Begin preparation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFood" name="Prepare the food"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded" name="Does the order include alcoholic beverages?" default="Flow_SkipAlcoholPreparation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages" name="Fetch wine and prepare other alcoholic beverages"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeSommelier" name="Sommelier preparation complete"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StartWaiterPreparation" name="Prepare cart and nonalcoholic drinks"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadyCart" name="Ready the cart"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" name="Prepare nonalcoholic drinks"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MergeWaiterPreparation" name="Waiter preparation complete"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AllReady" name="Food, wine, and cart ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Deliver the order to the guest's room"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnToStation" name="Return to the room-service station"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AnotherOrder" name="Does the waiter have another order to prepare or deliver?" default="Flow_DebitNow"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitToDebitAccount" name="Wait to debit the guest's account"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DebitAccount" name="Debit the guest's account"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderComplete" name="Room-service order complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_TakeOrder" sourceRef="Start_GuestCalls" targetRef="Task_TakeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TakeOrder_SubmitTicket" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitTicket_GiveSommelierOrder" sourceRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" targetRef="Task_GiveSommelierOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiveSommelierOrder_AssignWaiter" sourceRef="Task_GiveSommelierOrder" targetRef="Task_AssignWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssignWaiter_StartPreparation" sourceRef="Task_AssignWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_StartPreparation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartPreparation_Kitchen" sourceRef="Gateway_StartPreparation" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartPreparation_Sommelier" sourceRef="Gateway_StartPreparation" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartPreparation_Waiter" sourceRef="Gateway_StartPreparation" targetRef="Gateway_StartWaiterPreparation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded" targetRef="Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">orderIncludesAlcohol = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipAlcoholPreparation" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded" targetRef="Gateway_MergeSommelier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholPrepared" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages" targetRef="Gateway_MergeSommelier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_KitchenReady" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_AllReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SommelierReady" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeSommelier" targetRef="Gateway_AllReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaiterStart_Cart" sourceRef="Gateway_StartWaiterPreparation" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaiterStart_Nonalcoholic" sourceRef="Gateway_StartWaiterPreparation" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CartReady" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Gateway_MergeWaiterPreparation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NonalcoholicReady" sourceRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_MergeWaiterPreparation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaiterReady" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeWaiterPreparation" targetRef="Gateway_AllReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllReady_Deliver" sourceRef="Gateway_AllReady" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deliver_Return" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_AnotherOrder" sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation" targetRef="Gateway_AnotherOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeferBilling" sourceRef="Gateway_AnotherOrder" targetRef="Task_WaitToDebitAccount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">hasAnotherOrderToPrepareOrDeliver = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DebitNow" sourceRef="Gateway_AnotherOrder" targetRef="Task_DebitAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Debit" sourceRef="Task_WaitToDebitAccount" targetRef="Task_DebitAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Debit_End" sourceRef="Task_DebitAccount" targetRef="End_OrderComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
